name: Church / house of worship
summary: Houses of worship combine a tall, long-span assembly room (sanctuary/worship center) with fellowship hall, classrooms/children's wing and offices; cost swings with structure (pre-engineered metal vs. masonry/steel truss), acoustics and worship AV/lighting. Public data is thin: the hard cost is DERIVED (in 2019 dollars, escalated by the build script) from the RSMeans 2019 church model and one 2019 Texas megachurch permit value - low confidence, verify against local church-builder bids. Rule of thumb for the seat alternate unit: ~18-22 SF per seat in the worship room and ~40-60 total building SF per sanctuary seat.

typicalSize.method: RSMeans model 17,000 SF (e1); PaulAnn Baptist 35,000 SF (e2). Neighborhood congregations 5k-15k SF; regional churches 30k-100k+ SF. Mid 20,000 SF ~ 400-500-seat worship center with education wing.

primaryUnitsPerAcre.method: Building SF per site acre; worship uses are parking-driven (peak Sunday demand), so sites are large: ~3-5 acres for 20,000 SF. Derived.

parkingPerPrimaryUnit.method: Spaces per building SF (= 5-8 per 1,000 SF), from the common zoning ratio of 1 space per 3-4 sanctuary seats at ~40-60 building SF per seat. Derived; local code governs.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Derived, in 2019 dollars (both anchors are 2019). RSMeans church model hard cost w/o A/E = $133.31 x 1.25 = ~$167/SF building-only (e1, national); PaulAnn Baptist permit value ~$280/SF (e2, TX). Adding typical on-site work (large surface parking, stormwater, landscaping ~10%-15%) gives ~$185-$315; mid $240 ~ midpoint. Low $160 = pre-engineered metal worship building with simple finishes; high $375 = masonry/steel-truss sanctuary with acoustic treatment and higher finishes. Expect ~+40%-50% escalation to 2025-26 (BLS nonresidential PPI rose ~47% Dec 2019-Sep 2026 per the e2 source).

scope.notes: Contractor price incl. GC/OH&P, surface parking, on-site utilities and landscaping; excludes land, soft costs, pews/chairs and worship AV/lighting (line items / FF&E), organs, steeples, off-sites and fees.

qualityTiers.method: Low/mid and high/mid of the derived range ($160/$240 = 0.67; $375/$240 = 1.56), with luxury extended for traditional masonry/stone sanctuaries, stained glass and pipe organs.

systemSplit.method: Derived for a steel-truss assembly building (e1 model structure): metals 9% for long-span trusses, roofing/thermal 8% for a large roof area, finishes 10% incl. acoustic treatment, HVAC 11% for high-occupancy assembly ventilation; site 10%. Worship AV/lighting is carried as a separate line item, not in Div 27 here.

lineItems.name: Worship audio/video/theatrical lighting system

cost.method: PaulAnn Baptist: ~$2.0M for furniture and AV on 35,000 SF (~$57/SF combined, e3); AV/lighting alone taken at ~$15-$80 per building SF depending on production level.

lineItems.notes: Owner-procured or design-build AV integrator; scales with worship-room size.

lineItems.name: Sanctuary seating - pews or interlocking theater chairs (per seat)

cost.method: Derived: stackable/interlocking chairs ~$150, theater seats ~$300, custom hardwood pews ~$400-$600 per seat. Qty assumes ~1 seat per 40 building SF.

lineItems.notes: Counted in FF&E when seating is loose; listed here because seat count drives it.

cost.method: Derived: prefabricated fiberglass steeple (low) to masonry bell tower (high).
Derived: digital organ low; new pipe organ high.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Derived: loose furniture for fellowship hall, classrooms, offices and nursery (excl. worship AV and sanctuary seating line items). e3 implies ~$57/SF for furniture + AV combined in 2019.

pctOfHard.method: Derived. RSMeans church model carries architectural fees at 10% of building cost (e1); add survey/geotech, permits, testing, AV/acoustic consultants and owner's rep. Many churches use design-build church specialists, compressing fees toward the low end. Excludes FF&E and contingency.

softCosts.notes: Capital campaign and church-lender (bond/loan) costs belong in financing.

perPrimaryUnit.method: 2019 dollars: low ~ $160 hard x 1.1; high ~ $375 hard x 1.22 + furniture/AV (~$57/SF per e3).

source.title: RSMeans square foot cost model: Church (Decorative Concrete Block / Steel Truss), 1 story

evidence.quote: Model page cost table (17,000 SF, 2019 data): SubTotal $133.31/SF; Contractor Fees 25%; Architectural Fees 10%; Total Building Cost $183.3/SF (union)
evidence.scopeNotes: Building only, union labor, 2019 national average; includes contractor GC/OH&P (25%) AND architect fees; excludes sitework, land, FF&E. Hard cost w/o A/E fee = SubTotal x 1.25. Stale (2019) and well below current bids; used for relative ratios between types only.

source.title: Church Construction Cost Per Square Foot: RSMeans Benchmark

evidence.quote: Dividing the permit value by the 35,000 combined square feet gives roughly $280 per square foot
evidence.scopeNotes: PaulAnn Baptist Church: 25,000 SF sanctuary + 10,000 SF education wing; building permit value $9,790,000 (construction, likely excl. some sitework); total with furniture and AV approximately $11.8M, i.e. ~$2.0M (~$57/SF) for furniture and AV.

source.title: Church Construction Cost Per Square Foot: RSMeans Benchmark

evidence.quote: Permit: "$9,790,000"; total with furniture and AV: "approximately $11.8 million"

openQuestions: Only two anchors (RSMeans 2019 model and one 2019 Texas permit value); current church-builder bids, denominational facility guides or TX TABS registrations for churches are needed to replace this derived estimate.
Cost per seat (alternate unit) is not sourced; ~40-60 building SF per sanctuary seat is a planning assumption.
